owner of

  • CURIE: gmeow:ownerOf
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ownerOf
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/organization

Relates an agent to something it owns — an organization, an asset, a work. Non-functional and standpoint-indexable (contested ownership coexists, P9). The flat shortcut; promote to an ownership relator (with share, period, jurisdiction) when those matter. Projects to schema:owns.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Agent -> gmeow:Entity

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:ownerOf from gmeow:Agent to gmeow:Entity when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:Agent, gmeow:Entity
